label: Figure 21.3: Economic growth to remove a deflationary gap/output gap
alt: Panel (a): AD shifts right from AD1 to AD2 along the unchanged SRAS and LRAS, moving output from Y1 up to Yf. Panel (b): the PPC shows a movement from point a (inside the curve) to point b, close to but not exactly on the curve.
caption: Panel (a): an increase in aggregate demand from AD<sub>1</sub> to AD<sub>2</sub> moves the economy along SRAS until it reaches full-employment output Y<sub>f</sub>, closing the gap. Panel (b): the matching movement on the PPC is from point a (inside the curve) to point b, which sits close to – but not exactly on – the frontier, since some natural unemployment always remains.
